blocks.content: A Pod is the smallest thing Kubernetes will schedule. You never hand it a bare container; you hand it a Pod, and the Pod holds one or more containers that always run together on the same machine.

items: Containers in a Pod share one network namespace
They can reach each other on localhost
They share the Pod's storage volumes
They live and die as a unit

blocks.content:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  containers:
    - name: nginx
      image: nginx:1.27
      ports:
        - containerPort: 80
blocks.caption: The smallest Pod worth writing down.
